features.notes: Verifies the selected Stage 4 88 model: 52 white and 36 black keys, A-to-C range, hammer action, and black-key pattern.
Verifies six ordered sections and normalized ratios.
Verifies representative section controls, stable IDs, and the two-display rule.
Button toggles update state and program display.
Keyboard knob adjustment is clamped and reflected in its ARIA value.
Hardware controls have names, roles, and keyboard access.
Continuous instrument structure and no marketing hero region.
Shared note ownership, repeated notes, release, and all-notes-off paths.
Sustain and half-pedal state transitions are routed to the Piano engine.
Voice limits and deterministic ownership are covered by the audio boundary.
Touch curves and velocity response reach the audio engine.
Computer-key mapping suppresses repeats and clears on focus loss.
MIDI note, sustain, pedal, unavailable, and denied paths are injectable.
Master volume and reverb are connected to the shared audible graph.
Sample failure exposes a playable, labeled live-synthesis fallback.
Inherited Phase 1 visual and interaction coverage remains present.
